:against:  = AGAINST / NAY

⏭️  = NO OPINION / PRESENT

Say, is it possible for non-WA states to issue a "compliant passport" and force WA states to recognize their passports as legally valid, regardless of their diplomatic relations (or the lack thereof)?
I think you're right, though "yes you have a valid form of ID" doesn't mean "we're going to let you into the country"
I also think this proposal is unnecessary

I predict this proposal is going to be defeated, so it doesn't matter much anyways, but I dislike the WA forcing its own passport templates on member nations and I also don't like the precedent of renaming existing committees.
Changed the channel name: [Concluded] GA - Normalized Templates For Passports
